cards.subject: thyroid
cards.heading: Thyroid Function 101
title: How Your
Thyroid
Makes Hormones
cards.alt: The thyroid chain: the brain releases TSH, the thyroid makes T4, and T4 converts to the active hormone T3

steps.label: T4
steps.note: The thyroid produces it, but it is inactive

steps.label: T3
steps.note: T4 converts to the hormone cells actually use

cards.subject: Hashimoto
cards.heading: Hypothyroidism vs Hashimoto’s: Key Differences
title: Hypothyroidism vs
Hashimoto
’s
cards.alt: Hypothyroidism is an underactive thyroid; Hashimoto's is the autoimmune attack that most often causes it

rows.label: What it is
values: An autoimmune attack on the thyroid

rows.label: In the chain
values: The most common cause of it in the US

cards.subject: thyroid
cards.heading: When to Seek Medical Evaluation
title: When
Thyroid
Symptoms Need a Workup
cards.alt: See a doctor for severe fatigue, weight change, hair thinning, depression, neck swelling or symptoms despite medication

cards.subject: melatonin
cards.heading: Why OTC Melatonin Fails
title: Why Over-the-Counter
Melatonin
Fails
cards.alt: OTC melatonin fails on unreliable dosing, downregulating your own production, and next-morning grogginess

items.label: Unreliable dose
items.note: Tested products ran 0% to 667% of the label

items.label: Downregulation
items.note: Your own production can drop in response

items.label: Grogginess
items.note: Vivid dreams and a heavy next morning

cards.subject: melatonin
cards.heading: Circadian Rhythm Reset: Beyond the Pill
title: Resetting Your Clock Without
Melatonin
cards.alt: Reset your body clock with 15 minutes of morning sunlight and no blue light for an hour before bed

good.heading: Morning
items: Tells the pineal gland to stop melatonin

bad.heading: Evening
items: Cut blue light an hour before bed
No interruption to the natural rise

cards.subject: melatonin
cards.heading: Advanced Restoration: Beyond Traditional Sleep Aids
title: Melatonin
vs Epitalon vs Magnesium
cards.alt: Melatonin replaces the hormone, Epitalon aims to support the pineal gland, magnesium glycinate calms the nervous system

rows.label: What it does
values: Aims to support your own output

rows.label: Evidence
values: Sold as a supplement, dosing varies
Safe within the RDA for most adults

cards.subject: cortisol
cards.heading: What is Cortisol?
title: What
Cortisol
Actually Does
cards.alt: Cortisol regulates blood pressure, reduces inflammation, steadies blood glucose and follows a daily rhythm

items.label: Daily rhythm
items.note: Peaks in the morning, dips at night

cards.subject: cortisol
cards.heading: High vs. Low Cortisol Signs: Identifying the Imbalance
title: High vs Low
Cortisol
Signs
cards.alt: High cortisol brings weight gain and stretch marks; low cortisol brings fatigue, low blood pressure and salt cravings

good.heading: Too much cortisol
items: Weight gain in the face and abdomen
A fatty hump between the shoulders
High blood pressure and muscle weakness

bad.heading: Too little cortisol
items: Low blood pressure, faint on standing

cards.subject: cortisol
cards.heading: Functional Testing: Getting the Right Answers
title: How
Cortisol
Is Tested
cards.alt: Cortisol testing: a morning blood draw, saliva at four points, 24-hour urinary free cortisol, and the DUTCH test

items.label: Saliva, four points
items.note: Shows how levels rise and fall

items.label: 24-hour urinary free
items.note: Still the clinical standard for Cushing's

cards.subject: cortisol
cards.heading: When to Visit Urgent Care or an ER
cards.alt: Adrenal crisis needs emergency care: sudden severe pain, severe vomiting and diarrhoea, or low blood pressure and collapse
cards.headline: Go to the ER

signs.text: Sudden severe pain in the lower back, abdomen or legs
Severe vomiting and diarrhoea with dehydration
Low blood pressure or loss of consciousness

cards.subject: perimenopause
cards.heading: Common Symptoms You Shouldn’t Ignore
title: Common
Perimenopause
Symptoms
cards.alt: Common perimenopause symptoms: hot flashes and night sweats, insomnia, mood changes, and brain fog

items.label: Hot flashes
items.note: And night sweats, the most common complaint

cards.subject: perimenopause
cards.heading: Natural Relief: Evidence-Based Strategies
title: Natural
Perimenopause
Relief Options
cards.alt: Perimenopause relief options: calcium and vitamin D, phytoestrogens, progesterone cream with caution, and pelvic care

items.label: Diet foundations
items.note: Calcium and vitamin D, fewer hot-flash triggers

items.label: Phytoestrogens
items.note: Soy, flaxseed and red clover isoflavones

items.label: Progesterone cream
items.note: OTC bioidenticals are loosely regulated, ask first

cards.subject: perimenopause
cards.heading: When to See a Medical Professional
cards.alt: See a doctor in perimenopause for very heavy bleeding, periods closer than 21 days, or severe depression or anxiety
cards.headline: Get seen

signs.text: Soaking through a pad in an hour
Periods more often than every 21 days
Depression or anxiety interfering with daily life

cards.footer: These are not part of the normal transition

cards.subject: PCOS
cards.heading: What Actually Drives PCOS?
title: What Actually Drives
PCOS
cards.alt: PCOS root causes: genetics and environment, androgen excess, insulin resistance, inflammation and adrenal PCOS

items.label: Genetics and environment
items.note: Family history, plus what flips those genes

items.label: Insulin resistance
items.note: A driver for most women with PCOS

items.label: Chronic inflammation
items.note: Low-grade, and it fuels androgen production

items.label: Adrenal PCOS
items.note: 20 to 30% of cases, driven by stress

cards.subject: PCOS
cards.heading: Androgen Excess: More Than Just a Hormone
title: Signs of Androgen Excess in
PCOS
cards.alt: Androgen excess in PCOS shows as facial hair growth, jawline cystic acne, and male-pattern hair thinning

items.label: Hirsutism
items.note: Excess hair on the face or chin

cards.subject: PCOS
cards.heading: The Insulin Connection
title: How Insulin Drives
PCOS
cards.alt: In PCOS, cells resist insulin, the body makes more, and high insulin drives ovarian testosterone while SHBG falls

steps.label: Cells resist
steps.note: The key no longer opens the door

steps.label: More insulin
steps.note: The body pumps out more to compensate

cards.subject: PCOS
cards.heading: Cycle Regulation Diet
title: Eating to Steady
PCOS
Blood Sugar
cards.alt: A PCOS cycle-regulation plate: fiber first, protein at every meal, healthy fats, and anti-inflammatory colour

items.label: Fiber first
items.note: Greens, berries and seeds slow absorption

items.label: Healthy fats
items.note: Avocado, nuts and olive oil for hormone synthesis
